items.title: Initialize the repository
items.notes: The first commit adds the project README and establishes the repository.

items.title: Plan the V5 character creator
items.notes: PLAN.md records the proposed first-release scope, rules ledger, player workflow, and implementation sequence.

items.title: Document the project and initialize its roadmap
items.notes: The README links the contributor documentation, agent guidance, and shared roadmap contract.

items.title: Scaffold the Vite app
items.notes: Set up React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui. Record the supported runtime and working install, dev, and verification commands in Getting started.

items.title: Pin the V5 rules sources
items.notes: Select the Core Rulebook printing and applicable errata. Hand-check a standard clan neonate fixture and record the source for each rule used by the first build.

items.title: Build the Attribute and Skill ledger
items.notes: Evaluate dot distributions, Specialties, Health, and Willpower and expose the available slots and sources of each total.

items.title: Add the app favicon
items.notes: Add a Vampire-themed SVG icon and verify that the production page references it.

items.title: Build the first clan and Predator Type path
items.notes: Support one clan and one eligible Predator Type with Discipline allocation, powers, mandatory grants, dependent choices, and validation.

items.title: Evaluate Advantages, Flaws, and starting XP
items.notes: Track starting budgets and ordered purchases. Verify Generation, Humanity, Blood Potency, and the XP balance for the first fixture.

items.title: Complete the first character guide and print sheet
items.notes: Verified Mara Vale through all six guide steps and compared her evaluated sheet with one-page US Letter and A4 printouts. Confirmed that an unfinished sheet retains its Draft label in print.

items.title: Expand the core option catalog
items.notes: Added and tested all seven named Core clans and ten Predator Types, source-tagged searchable pickers, and manual entries for Storyteller review. Verified a complete Tremere Bagger build, Ventrue restrictions, and Osiris allocations in the browser.

items.title: Save named browser drafts
items.notes: Named V5 drafts autosave the character and current step. Verified independent reloads for a completed Mara Vale build and an unfinished draft. An injected quota error preserved the previous save and let the current draft download as JSON, then retry and restore.

items.title: Support JSON backup and restore
items.notes: Validated and previewed versioned V5 JSON backups before restoring copies with fresh IDs. Verified complete Mara Vale and unfinished draft round-trips, reload and name collision handling, and preservation of saved drafts after cancellation, rejected files, and a failed storage write.

items.title: Share mechanical build links
items.notes: Added versioned, allowlisted build links, a read-only preview, and an explicit save-as-copy action. Verified Mara Vale’s decoded payload excludes names and narrative, custom choices produce omission flags, invalid links are rejected, and opening a preview leaves saved drafts intact.

items.title: Export the Storyteller brief
items.notes: Added a Storyteller Markdown preview and download with mechanics, open rulings, and opt-in narrative and custom text. Verified that completed Mara Vale and unfinished draft previews match the download, and that private text stays out until selected.

items.title: Verify the first release
items.notes: Verified 45 tests, type checking, a production build, creation through restore and print at 1440 px and 390 px, and one-page US Letter and A4 sheets. Verified the Dark Pack logo, copyright and trademark notice, and unofficial designation on the live creator and shared build preview. External sample feedback remains pending in docs/release-verification.md.

items.title: Add standard-clan fledgling creation
items.notes: Added the newly Embraced standard-clan fledgling profile. Verified Rowan Pike through review, a one-page US Letter print, browser reload, JSON backup restore, and the read-only mechanical link. Verified that the first-release Mara Vale browser draft, JSON backup, and build link retain the original neonate mechanics.

items.title: Add standard-clan ancilla creation
items.notes: Added Core ancilla creation and rank-four Discipline powers. Built Silas Ward through browser review, checked the 35 XP journal in both orders, reloaded after switching to Neonate, paused Predator Type and XP under Fledgling, then restored the ancilla sheet and opened its mechanical link. Automated checks cover the hand calculations, prerequisites, Blood Potency, and draft and backup round-trips.

items.title: Add Caitiff creation
items.notes: Added the Core Caitiff choice across all supported age profiles, including the Discipline allocation, six-times XP cost, learning confirmation, Suspect, and positive Status restriction. Verified Nessa Reed through browser review, a one-page US Letter print, JSON backup restore as a separate draft, and reload. Automated checks cover older drafts and Caitiff transfers.

items.title: Add Thin-blood creation
items.notes: Added Core Thin-blood fledgling creation with matched Merits and Flaws, Clan Curse, Discipline Affinity, and starting Alchemy. Verified Iris Calder through browser review, a one-page US Letter print, JSON restore and reload, and a read-only build link. Confirmed that incompatible ages and trait combinations are flagged and that older drafts remain readable.

items.title: Add an opt-in Player’s Guide source pack
items.notes: Added the Ministry, Extortionist, Montero, Pursuer, Chimerstry, and Fata Morgana with source references, grants, and prerequisites. Verified Elias Voss through browser review, JSON restore and reload, and a mechanical link. Both previews distinguished disabled selections from unknown source IDs. Core remains the default.

items.title: Add a post-creation XP advancement journal
items.notes: Added earned XP awards and ordered purchases on top of the completed creation build. Verified Mara Vale’s 55 earned XP, 53 spent, and 2 remaining in Review & Print, including Amalgam purchase order, award removal, a pause after editing creation, named draft reload, and restoring the downloaded JSON as a separate draft. The sheet and Storyteller brief show advancement alongside starting XP. Mechanical links continue to share the creation build.

items.title: Add reusable chronicle presets
items.notes: Added named browser-local presets for the chronicle name, Tenets, and enabled rule sources. The preview shows current and preset values before applying them. Verified cancellation, independent reuse in Mara and Rowan’s drafts, a narrow viewport, named-draft reload, and JSON backup restore as a third draft. Applied values use the existing draft fields.

items.title: Add a searchable V5 table reference
items.notes: Added a searchable dialog for creation budgets, XP costs, Discipline prerequisites, and derived tracks with book and page citations. Verified keyboard search by rule and page, focus return on Escape, scrolling at 390 px, layout at 320 px, and return to the same Relationships step with named and unsaved draft edits intact.

items.title: Add a Relationship Map for one character
items.notes: Added a map seeded from the sire, coterie, and Touchstones, with keyboard-accessible editing for added people and labeled connections. Verified live relationship changes, a 390 px viewport, and restoring Mara’s downloaded backup as a separate draft that reopened at Relationships. The decoded mechanical link contained no relationship details and matched the link from before the map edits.

items.title: Add a coterie and Domain planner with a portable handoff
items.notes: Added named local plans with multiple members, optional Relationship Map details, shared purpose, and Domain ratings and notes. Verified the handoff preview at 390 px, download, import cancellation, restore as a separate plan, and reload. In the browser Mara and Rowan retained their original relationships and saved steps. Automated coverage verifies that plan operations leave the character library byte-for-byte unchanged.

items.title: Scope a private Storyteller workspace
items.notes: Defined an invite-only chronicle inbox for previewed brief snapshots and a Storyteller review response. Documented role access, player control of character data, per-handoff export, withdrawal, member removal, and chronicle deletion. The next priority is a local prototype with fictional roles to inform a hosted pilot decision. External handoff feedback is deferred.

items.title: Prototype private handoff review with fictional data
items.notes: Verified one fictional Storyteller and two players in the local browser: invitations, role visibility, submission, review, replacement with revised XP, per-handoff JSON export, and withdrawal without affecting the other player. Documented the walkthrough and deferred a hosted pilot pending player and Storyteller feedback.

items.title: Jump from review issues to the affected character choices
items.notes: Each open review choice focuses its field or option group. Verified distinct targets using Enter and Space and focus and scrolling at 390 px. A one-page native print preview of Mara showed the Draft marker. Buying Drive 2 with the last 6 XP cleared the open choice and the marker from the shared review and print sheet. The second native preview could not be inspected. See docs/release-verification.md.

items.title: Show open rulings alongside the Storyteller brief preview
items.notes: Showed the same evaluated rulings beside the Markdown on desktop and above it at 390 px. Verified keyboard opening, opt-ins, and download. Compared both downloaded files with the visible ruling about the last 6 starting XP for Mara Vale. Covered redaction and Markdown escaping for custom purchase names.

items.title: Point players to the matching JSON restore control
items.notes: Both restore controls identify valid files for the other tool and name the matching picker. Verified both directions with the documented samples, malformed JSON rejection, preservation of the open draft and step and unsaved plan edit, and reopening the saved draft and plan after reload.

items.title: Add a live character summary to the editing steps
items.notes: Added a desktop summary and mobile disclosure powered by the existing evaluator. Verified live age, clan, Predator Type, track, XP, and progress changes across editing steps, Tab, Space, and Enter at 390 px, and all expected values when restoring and reloading the named Mara Vale draft.

items.title: Verify print output for incomplete and expanded character builds
items.notes: Verified eight PDFs from the production review screen. The Draft marker appeared before the final 6 XP purchase and cleared after it on Letter and A4. Tightened print spacing to avoid a nearly empty second page. Both the Thin-blood and advancement fixtures printed on one readable page per size with complete sections and expected ratings and XP.

items.title: Duplicate the current browser draft as a named copy
items.notes: Added a suggested name and a fresh ID for copies of the current named draft. Verified the working inputs and current step carried over and both drafts reopened independently after reload. A stale-tab save left the original open and preserved the newer saved data. A quota test confirmed the stored library stays intact on a failed copy.
